title: Sufficient
text: Sufficient. With the high cost of furniture now, this is a good enough alternative if you need a desk. It is a bit to assemble and it's not perfect. But, for the money I'm happy with it.

product_metadata.title: Sauder 423912 Steel River Desk, Carbon Oak Finish
features: Two drawers feature metal runners and safety stops to keep you and your family safe. Open shelf for storage of office supplies.
Finished on all sides for versatile placement anywhere in your home. Textured, powder coated metal frame and corner accents.
SPECIFICATIONS: Assembled Dimensions - W: 23.465 x L: 47.48 x H: 29.528 --- FINISH: Unit comes finished in Sauder's Carbon Oak
Delivered direct to your door by a small parcel delivery service such as; UPS or FedEx. This will be a contactless delivery.
description: Rustic-inspired style is just what you need to get motivated for your next big project. Update your home office or workspace with the one-of-a-kind design and beauty of this desk from the Steel River collection. Its spacious top surface provides you with the room you need for all your desk essentials like your laptop, a cup full of pens, a stack of notepads and of course your coffee mug. It also has room for items like picture frames and knick-knacks too. This computer desk features two drawers that open and close on smooth metal runners. The pencil drawer is ideal for easy access storage of items like pencils, paper clips, and rubber bands. The large lower drawer is great for storing books, magazines, and other miscellaneous items. It also includes an open shelf for additional storage space. This home office desk features a textured, powdercoated metal frame and rear crossbars for stability. Finished on all sides in Carbon Oak.
